review_scope: Linear CuraEngine 5.13.0 output, single extruder, millimetres, fixed 0.2 mm layers including the initial layer, 1.75 mm filament and PLA density 1.24 g/cm3.

tests: 10 mm straight rod mass, COM and analytic inertia
STL-to-machine translation is removed from COM and inertia
Rotated frame transforms segment inertia correctly
M82/M83, G90/G91, G92 XYZ/E and stationary retraction recovery
Support, interface and skirt are excluded from model properties
Moving recovery deposits only its fresh-material tail
Unsupported units, volumetric E, arcs and extruding Z moves fail explicitly

independent_math_checks.quadrature_method: Endpoint and midpoint weights 1/6, 4/6 and 1/6 integrate line first and second moments exactly.
independent_math_checks.line_second_moment_formula: Q = sum_i mass_i * (outer(midpoint_i - COM, midpoint_i - COM) + outer(delta_i, delta_i)/12)
independent_math_checks.inertia_formula: I_kg_m2 = (trace(Q) * identity - Q) * 1e-6 when coordinates in Q are millimetres
independent_math_checks.layer_height_correction: Subtract half the fixed layer height from machine Z before converting into the original STL frame.

frame_schema_check.units: Matrix translations and returned COM are millimetres; inertia is kg m2.

resolved_findings.title: Travel curves must not leave the current position stale
resolved_findings.previous_effect: Travel G2 to X10 followed by a deposited line to X20 gave COM X10 instead of X15.
resolved_findings.verification: G2, G3 and G5 now fail even when E is absent.

resolved_findings.title: Validate the complete rigid homogeneous transform
resolved_findings.previous_effect: A malformed bottom row was accepted because only the 3x3 rotation was checked.
resolved_findings.verification: Malformed bottom rows and reflections now fail; the supplied suite also rejects non-finite translation.

limitations: This review does not establish correctness for arbitrary printer G-code, startup homing or externally changed firmware state.
Deposited E is commanded filament. Actual filament diameter, density, extrusion calibration, pressure and shrinkage require measurement.
The mass model distributes fresh material uniformly along each deposited segment and treats moving retraction recovery as a non-depositing prefix.
The line model and optional rectangular bead correction approximate mass distribution; neither reconstructs bead overlap or proves printed strength.
A variable or different initial layer height would require a corresponding per-layer centre correction. The frozen profile uses 0.2 mm for both.

references.title: Marlin M82 absolute extrusion and G90/G91 interaction
